Grep src/ for the bare token `any` and for @ts-ignore/@ts-expect-error/eslint-disable directives and remove every one of them. Keep the change purely declarative: JSDoc and type annotations only, every function must do exactly what it did before, no new imports, no branch or statement changes, and nothing under test/ may be touched.
